description: customManagers:dockerfileVersions picks up the annotated ARG in the
Dockerfile that pins taylorwilsdon/google_workspace_mcp, which is a git
tag rather than a package and would otherwise go unwatched. This is the
pin that mattered most: it used to be an unpinned clone, so the image
silently carried whatever upstream HEAD was on build day.
minimumReleaseAge holds updates for 5 days, matching the other wrappers.
Upstream ships roughly weekly and has published same-week hotfixes.

packageRules.description: Proxy plumbing moves together; the upstream MCP gets its own PR.
Upstream backend is the one to read release notes for.
